posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Got it on my third try.  Unity was MVP (not to be confused with an MDP) with two Platform bots, Mr. Chomps, Champion bot, Stealth bot, and Swift bot for oodles of damage, even with DR.  AZ  knocked out two Living Forcefields with a Fueled Freeze and got in some good damage with a well set-up Hoarfire + Coolant Blast combo, while Bunker held down the fort with two Adhesive-foam Grenades (and got in some regular grenades as well).

 

Had Blade half dead on his second side when Scum and Villany pulled out a Hasten Doom and a Slash and Burn.  Stealth bot managed to preserve my entire army from the Doom at the cost of her life, but the Slash and Burn took out a Platform Bot.  Volitile Parts hurt the Baron for that offense, as did AZ when it turned out that he was the highest HP hero when Blade came burning.  This put Blade at 6 hp, when on his turn he played... Devious Distruption.  But his deviousness was not enough to save him from my army of exploding robots.

 

After a challenge like that, let's take a break and shoot fish in a barrel.

 

Visionary, Legacy, Ra, Fanatic, and Absolute Zero to squish Grand Warlord Voss in Insula Primalis.  Bonus points if you drop him from over 50 hp in one strike.

posts.name: Deimir
posts.cooked:
It took more than a dozen tries over the course of three weeks, but I finally managed to eke out a Relic win. Once I got the first relic down (the zombie Bag), the environment swung things in my favor and I got the detective, so I could continue manipulating the top of Gloomweaver's deck while keeping Wraith's power open for massive relic damage with Razor Ordnance and Targeting Computer. Used Smoke Bombs to keep redirecting the damage onto Nightmist, who burned through her whole deck twice over the course of the game to power a 22 card and 20 card Mist-fueled Recovery.

 

Early game, Mr Fixer and Expatriette pulled AoE damage duty with Assault Rifle+Shock Rounds, and Monkey Fist+Jack Handle to sweep up Zombies. The second relic (Drum) showed up the turn after I killed the Bag. Only took 2 turns to kill the Drum, and the Grimoire showed up immediately after that. Once the Grimoire was on top of the deck, I let the detective die and the Grimoire came into play, then on Nightmist's turn I shut down Gloomweaver's deck, which was a good thing cuz the environment spit out Scum & Villainy. Killed the stupid book on the second pass, and just waited for Gloomy's turn to come back around. A Falling Statuary came out of nowhere and conked Fixer on the head at the last second, so I was denied a flawless victory.

 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=492041190

 

Now it's time for some high-tech heroics! Bunker, Unity, Wraith, and Absolute Zero against Advanced Ambuscade at Wagner Mars Base. Shouldn't be too hard, but we could use a breather after that last challenge, methinks.

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
I'd say that the thread was hibernating.  It's Spring now, time to wake up!

 

That was a rather intense match.  Started out fairly low key - an opening Undivided Attention, and then the Fence and his Thief.  On the other hand, the heroes didn't have enough firepower to deal with them!  (Well, Oblivion, but it seemed prudent to save that.)  But a lucky Timeshift on Tempest flipped a Aquatic Correspondence, which drew into a Localized Hurricane, and we were in business.

Then the board flooded (as it does facing the Chairman), and a squipped Oblivion and a Prison Break right after the Chairman flipped meant that we had it rough for a few turns.  But O-X had Ablative Coating and Reactive Plating Subroutine to absorb damage and return fire, and Bio-Engineering Beam to take out Char (who came out twice!).  And a 3/3 Oblivion with Imbued Fire does a very nice job of clearing the field.

We were pretty low on health by that point, but everyone stayed in jail like they are supposed to, and the team made short work of the Chairman and the Operative, with the final blow being a Reactive Plating Strike reacting to the Chairman's retaliation against O-X's Bio-engineering Beam.

 

 

Hmm....
